root_cause_read.MS: This is not a Risk failure. The source-aware reviewer found no material/critical increase, but all six prospective USE/ASK replies showed zero observable source contribution and Quality was 1-3. Several curated sources were novel yet not response-useful (for example, a name-only fact or a past episode unrelated to the current support move). The V1.1 curation operationalized absence-from-current-context more strongly than counterfactual response utility, while the Llama executor retained discretion to ignore the resource. Candidate usefulness and executor realization therefore both require repair before selector work.
root_cause_read.MP: Quality improved 5-1 with no Risk increase, but all five CONSTRAIN cases had zero profile-attributable incremental constraint. The generic job/education facts did not uniquely change wording, burden, timing, format, logistics, or a practical option. Query-level invitation to give advice was insufficient to guarantee a modifiable baseline slot. A plan-first, constraint-second interface with genuinely actionable profile fields is required.
not_supported: treating the MP Quality result alone as MP Function or MP_pass
treating safe nonuse as MS Function or MS_pass
proceeding to selector freezing or any formal external test
lowering the frozen Function threshold or deleting cases

next_required_repair.MS: Prospectively curate source-current pairs by counterfactual response-plan delta, not novelty alone; require a safe, relevant response move that cannot be obtained from full current context, then make the pre-decided USE/ASK move explicit in the response plan while keeping IGNORE resources physically absent.
next_required_repair.MP: Freeze a concrete R0 response plan first, identify an actual modifiable slot, then apply only actionable profile constraints to that slot; exclude generic occupation/education facts that cannot support a unique bounded constraint.
next_required_repair.sequencing: Build new owner-unique zero-API repair packets and frozen gates first. Do not fit selectors, rescue ME, or enter ESConv/EvoEmo/ES-MemEval until both treatments demonstrate Quality, Risk, and Function.
